entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: A young Temur hunter who spears the aven interpreter and later kills the Atarka broodling, and feels drawn to Tae Jin.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: A young whisperer who moves a boulder with earth magic to shield Tae Jin and later traps the broodling with a rock.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The former Temur chief and leader of the hunting party, who secretly signals to kill the Ojutai broodling and guides the party to Ugin's grave.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: A young Jeskai wanderer bearing a dragon mark of a ghostfire warrior, who recites Ugin's story and wields a spectral ice blade.

entities.name: Fec
entities.description: An orc hunter who advises caution and fights the broodling.

entities.name: Mattak
entities.description: A hunter on sentry duty.

entities.name: Oiyan
entities.description: One of Yasova's dependable hunters.

entities.name: Darka
entities.description: One of Yasova's dependable hunters.

entities.name: Rakhan
entities.description: One of Yasova's dependable hunters.

entities.name: Sorya
entities.description: One of Yasova's dependable hunters.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon whose first-person story Tae Jin recites, about wandering with and following his twin Nicol.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ugin's twin, who hates humans and promises vengeance for their sister; in the story he claims a cunning plan.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: A large, red-crested dragon who with his siblings terrorizes human settlements and chases Nicol.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: A reddish-green dragon who steals the twins' kills and warns them away from the birth mountain.

entities.name: Te Ju Ki
entities.description: The wise human elder who taught Ugin to spin globes of light representing planes.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: The twins' older brother who rules a human colony.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The Dragonlord who rules the territory and demands meat tribute; she hates and fears magic.

entities.name: Atarka's broodling
entities.description: A red antlered dragon that follows the party, kills the Ojutai broodling, and then attacks the camp before Naiva kills it.

entities.name: Ojutai's broodling
entities.description: A pale dragon that tries to kill Tae Jin with ice breath and is later killed by the Atarka broodling.

entities.name: Aven interpreter
entities.description: An aven who translates for the Ojutai broodling and is killed by Naiva's and Yasova's spears.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A Dragonlord whose broodling hunts Tae Jin.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: A figure who made a bargain that all ghostfire warriors would die to spare the rest of the Jeskai.

entities.name: The Temur
entities.description: The clan of Yasova and her granddaughters.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The people of Tae Jin.

entities.name: Ghostfire warriors
entities.description: Warriors bearing a dragon mark, supposedly all doomed by Shu Yun's bargain.

entities.name: Windfolk
entities.description: Elementals that gave Baishya a vision.

entities.name: Ugin's grave
entities.description: A chasm with a blue haze toward which the party travels.

entities.name: The birth mountain
entities.description: The mountain where Nicol and Ugin hatched; now surrounded by human settlements that mount dragon skulls on gates.

entities.name: Ayagor
entities.description: The gathering place where meat is delivered to Atarka.

entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: A mountain range seen from the party's camp.

entities.name: Dragon hunters
entities.description: Human settlers who have turned dragon corpses into trophies and attack dragons with poisoned bolts.

events.summary: As the Ojutai broodling prepares to kill Tae Jin, Yasova secretly signals the hunters to kill.
events.quote: Keeping her hand hidden from the aven on the rock, Grandmother gestured Kill .

events.summary: Baishya rolls a boulder to block the broodling's ice breath, and Naiva and Yasova kill the aven interpreter with spears.
events.quote: Grandmother cast her own spear, and the weapon struck the aven's head for the death blow.

events.summary: The broodling shoves aside the boulder as it looms over the twins, but an Atarka broodling slams into it.
events.quote: The two beasts went tumbling over the grass, grappling and clawing.

events.summary: Baishya admits she did not know she could move a rock like that.
events.quote: I didn't either,

events.summary: Yasova decides to go on to Ugin's grave, accepting the portent of Tae Jin's arrival and the windfolk's vision.
events.quote: We will go on to Ugin's grave.

events.summary: Yasova asks Tae Jin to continue Ugin's story, especially about Bolas.
events.quote: Tell me more about Ugin. And about Bolas.

events.summary: Flashback in Ugin's words: Ugin flies alone back across the land toward the birth mountain, finding solitude difficult and learning that all things breathe.
events.quote: But slowly as I flew and hunted my way back across the wide, wild land, I began to hear how all things breathe.

events.summary: Flashback: Ugin finds Vaevictis Asmadi and his siblings chasing Nicol while burning human settlements.
events.quote: They were chasing a dragon.

events.summary: Flashback: Ugin frightens Vaevictis off with spun globes of light so Nicol can escape.
events.quote: So, I reached into my tiny arsenal of magical tricks and spun a pair of transparent, feather-light globes out of the nexus of colors and into the air.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol reunites with Ugin and mocks Te Ju Ki, claiming no human can be as wise as the youngest dragon.
events.quote: No human, however old, can ever be as wise as the youngest dragon

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol tells Ugin of other lands across the ocean and refuses to consider that other dragons may be older.
events.quote: We are the first, after all, and thus the most powerful.

events.summary: Flashback: Palladia-Mors steals the twins' kills and warns them that humans near the birth mountain think they are dragon hunters.
events.quote: Those humans have gotten above themselves and think they are dragon hunters.

events.summary: Flashback: the twins reach the birth mountain and find human settlements with dragon skulls and carved gates showing dragons being killed.
events.quote: They have turned our sister into an ornament!

events.summary: Flashback: humans fire poisoned bolts, wounding Ugin, and fight to bathe in his fallen blood.
events.quote: Although Nicol twisted out of their way, my left rear claw was cut by a glancing blow.

events.summary: Flashback: Ugin lands on the mountain's rim and Nicol vows to avenge their sister, claiming a cunning plan that needs no killing.
events.quote: I have a plan, a very cunning plan, because I have taught myself to do something no one else can do.

events.summary: Yasova's party camps; at dusk Naiva tells Tae Jin that Yasova brings children to Ugin's grave to wake their magic early.
events.quote: Atarka hates magic. She fears it.

events.summary: Tae Jin says his master believes some essence of Ugin endures and reached out, which is why he was sent.
events.quote: The tempests that birth dragons have increased in strength since Ugin's death.

events.summary: The wounded Atarka broodling carries the dead Ojutai dragon to the camp and attacks, calling them traitors.
events.quote: Come out! My cousin tells me truth before she dies. Traitor! Dragon killer!

events.summary: Tae Jin conjures a ghostly blade and slashes open the broodling's belly.
events.quote: the white sparks elongated to become a long ghostly blade that shimmered, bright yet without physical substance

events.summary: Naiva kills the broodling by driving her spear through its eye.
events.quote: Naiva thrust the obsidian point of her spear into the dragon's unblinking eye

events.summary: Yasova identifies Tae Jin's dragon mark as that of a ghostfire warrior and demands to know how he exists.
events.quote: You wear the dragon mark of a ghostfire warrior.

relations.quote: At least they would die as they had been born: together.
Her entire life she had watched her grandmother, Yasova, once known as Dragonclaw of the Temur clan
because we are twins and we should share everything.

relations.note: taught him magic of globes of light
relations.quote: They are a magic that Te Ju Ki has been teaching me.

relations.note: Vaevictis and siblings chase Nicol; Nicol calls them hateful creatures
relations.quote: They're hateful creatures who haven't one brain to rub between the four of them.
Whatever happened to me, I could not allow him to die.

relations.note: carries its body to the camp
relations.quote: the Atarka broodling was carrying the limp body of the Ojutai dragon in its claws.

relations.note: she spears it through the eye
relations.quote: The beast shuddered and with a last gasp coughed up glowing embers.

relations.note: her spear delivers the death blow
relations.quote: Grandmother cast her own spear, and the weapon struck the aven's head for the death blow.

relations.note: Atarka hates magic and the whisperers Yasova hides
relations.quote: Grandmother thought if she could learn early which children are likely to become whisperers, she could better hide them from Atarka's wrath.

relations.note: a trusted hunter who defers to the First Mother
relations.quote: The First Mother had spoken, so it was settled.
